scope: C++ inference engine weight-only quantization: INT8 + true-4-bit packed INT4

design.export: cpp_export.py quantize_bits param (8/4) + XINGCHENG_NATIVE_QUANTIZATION env fallback; per-tensor symmetric quantization of every nn.Linear weight except lm_head / MoE router / embeddings (mirrors quantize_model); int4 uses true 4-bit packing (2 values/byte, low nibble even index, +8 offset)
design.bundle: per-tensor dtype field float64|int8|int4_packed + per-tensor scale; manifest config.quantization = none|int8|int4
design.engine: WeightBundle::load dtype dispatch dequantizes quantized tensors once at load into owned fp64 buffers — all downstream GEMMs unchanged; validate_supported accepts int8/int4, fp8 stays fail-closed

validation.tests: 26 passed in 7.91s (4 new: int8 logits parity, int4 logits parity + blob <1/4 fp64, quantized greedy generate + generate_batch vs quantized PyTorch reference, fail-closed fp8/missing-scale/bad-bits)
validation.parity: engine logits match quantize_model(n_bits) PyTorch reference within atol/rtol 2e-3 (same dequantized weights, fp32-vs-fp64 only)
validation.greedy: quantized engine generate matches quantized PyTorch Generator token-for-token; batch path verified on quantized bundle
validation.size: int4 bundle weights.bin < fp64_bytes/4 on tiny fixture

remaining: KV INT8 cache (per-token/per-head) and per-channel/group-wise quantization are separate blueprint items; CUDA still fail-closed
